note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor after the userns conversion. The unit's only change since the last verdict is userns.Enter(t) as its first statement (the child re-runs the whole body in its own user, network and mount namespace; a child failure or skip propagates to the parent, and a child that ran nothing fails it) plus removal of EPERM/EACCES skips, so a refused privilege now fails instead of skipping. Assertions are byte-identical. Section 2.0, the four-item digest composition (pseudo-header, TCP header without options with checksum zero, segment data, key). TestRFC2385CapturedSegmentsHaveIndependentDigests runs keyed RealDialer/RealListenerFactory across namespaces and checks every captured packet with an oracle that hashes the captured addresses, protocol and TCP length, the 20-byte header with checksum zeroed, the payload and rfc2385Key without the kernel's verifier; it requires SYN, pure ACK, data, FIN and FIN-ACK in both directions and exact data totals. Negative TestRFC2385MalformedWireSignaturesAreDropped: a corrupted digest gets no reply while an independently composed signed SYN gets a verified SYNACK.
